RedWallet XBT 8.0.1 (1792915404)

Adds distinct CoinJoin progress and error messages for connection, participant validation and local wallet inventory. Preserves the original failure when participation is stopped, and distinguishes reserved coins from released reservations.

Includes prior roster, watch-only and Lightning inventory, transaction fallback and v3/v4 compatibility repairs. CoinJoin remains Experimental. The exact physical-iPhone failure is still under investigation; hosted iOS startup, wallet, TLS and funded regtest checks passed for this source. This does not establish a successful live CoinJoin round.

Review amounts, recipients and fees before signing. Mixing does not guarantee anonymity; the relay can see your IP and your backend can see address queries. Follow displayed reservation and recovery requirements.
